description: RestoreNet: Collaboration to Improve Success of Seed-Based Restoration on the Colorado Plateau is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. RestoreNet tests the effectiveness of different combinations of restoration treatments and seeded plant species in a small scale, low risk environment. Researchers co-produce this knowledge with land managers to inform practices that are likely to be successful following large-scale disturbance across the southwestern U.S. and Colorado Plateau. Coverage: Colorado Plateau (2022). The toolkit gives Colorado Plateau as the location, 2022 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
